visualization.title: ClinicalTrials.gov network of melanoma trials by drug, showing trial counts
visualization.summary: Across 38 drug nodes and 130 connections (total 1,446 trials), pembrolizumab is highest (250), and the strongest link is Ipilimumab–Nivolumab (122).
